name: Chocolate Pistachio Oat Milk Latte
caffeineNote: Pop & Bottle's Amazon listing states 50 mg per 8 fl oz can
summary: From Pop & Bottle's Amazon listing and not yet checked against a can: cold brew on oat milk with chocolate and pistachio butter, sweetened with organic coconut nectar, at 50 mg of caffeine and 160 calories in an 8 oz can. Dairy-free and vegan, but it contains pistachio, a tree nut. The listing gives no sugar or protein figures.
